description: Customer age field containing 30 records with no missing values, ranging from -5 to 66 years with 24 distinct values. Data quality issues include one text representation ('Twenty-five', 3.3% of records) that cannot be parsed as numeric, and two values (-5 and 4) flagged as potentially unrealistic for service accounts.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert text representation to numeric equivalent (3.3% of records): 'Twenty-five' → '25'.
[CLARIFY] Review unrealistic age values (-5 and 4) to confirm whether these represent data entry errors, default values, or organizational accounts.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values are positive integers within a reasonable age range (e.g., 0-120) after standardization.
